verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a banking API and core-platform product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of Increase's core. Increase's hosted Sandbox, its OpenAPI spec and its official CLI are all hosted or client-side tools and do not count as self-hosting, and community posts describe Increase as an API layer run on top of partner banks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
